comments.body_html:
Attention!
This latest update (1.0.1) does NOT require you to overwrite your configs, if you have the previous version (1.0.0) installed. Drag the ‘data’ and ‘src’ folders across, along with the package.json.

Changelog 1.0.1: Added armor damage % to ammo description
Added missing items
- 7.62x54mm R FMJ
- 7.62x54mm R SP BT
- 7.62x54mm R HP BT
- 4.6x30mm JSP SX
- 9x19mm FMJ M882
- .300 Blackout CBJ
- 7.62x39mm FMJ
- 12/70 Piranha
- 23x75mm Barrikada slug

Thank you
